subject: general
question: Union Agriculture Minister Narendra Singh Tomar announced in October 2022 that the central government will launch a ________ crore accelerator programme to support the productive ideas of agro businesses.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 500**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Union Agriculture Minister Narendra Singh Tomar announced in **October 2022** that the central government will launch a **500-crore** accelerator programme to support the productive ideas of agro-businesses.
 
• The programme will provide financial assistance, mentorship, and other resources to agri-startups that are working on innovative solutions to** improve the agricultural sector**. The goal of the programme is to help these startups scale up their operations and make a significant impact on the Indian economy.
 
• The accelerator programme will be implemented by the **Department of Agriculture, Cooperation, and Farmers Welfare** (DAC&FW).
 
• The DAC&FW has already started the process of identifying eligible startups and will be inviting applications soon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The current Union Agriculture Minister of India is **Narendra Singh Tomar**.
 
• He was sworn in on** May 30, 2019, as a part of the Narendra Modi-led government**.
 
• He is also the Minister of **Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying**.
 
• Tomar is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has been a Member of Parliament (MP) since **1996.**
 
• He represents the **Morena constituency in Madhya Pradesh**.
